Helper Functions
```{r}
mode_value <- function(x) {
  ux <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  if (length(ux) == 0) return(NA)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

safe_char <- function(x, default = "Unknown") {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[is.na(x) | trimws(x) == ""] <- default
  x
}

safe_num <- function(x, default = 0) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  x[is.na(x) | is.infinite(x)] <- default
  x
}

calc_metrics <- function(y_true, probs, threshold = 0.5) {
  pred <- ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)

  cm <- table(
    factor(pred, levels = c(0, 1)),
    factor(y_true, levels = c(0, 1))
  )

  TN <- cm[1,1]
  FN <- cm[1,2]
  FP <- cm[2,1]
  TP <- cm[2,2]

  precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FP))
  recall    <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FN))
  f1         <- ifelse((precision + recall) == 0, 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
  accuracy   <- (TP + TN) / sum(cm)

  pos <- probs[y_true == 1]
  neg <- probs[y_true == 0]

  roc_auc <- if (length(unique(y_true)) == 2) as.numeric(pROC::auc(y_true, probs)) else NA_real_
  pr_auc  <- if (length(pos) > 0 && length(neg) > 0) {
    PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = FALSE)$auc.integral
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    Accuracy = accuracy,
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    F1 = f1,
    AUC_ROC = roc_auc,
    AUC_PR = pr_auc
  )
}

make_kaggle_style_narrative <- function(df) {
  apply(df, 1, function(row) {
    paste(
      "Claim filed for a", row[["Make"]],
      row[["VehicleCategory"]],
      "under", row[["BasePolicy"]], "policy.",
      "Accident area:", row[["AccidentArea"]], ".",
      "Driver age:", row[["Age"]], ".",
      "Driver sex:", row[["Sex"]], ".",
      "Marital status:", row[["MaritalStatus"]], ".",
      "Fault category:", row[["Fault"]], ".",
      "Claim amount:", row[["ClaimAmount"]], ".",
      "Vehicle price:", row[["VehiclePrice"]], ".",
      "Deductible:", row[["Deductible"]], ".",
      "Driver rating:", row[["DriverRating"]], ".",
      "Past claims:", row[["PastNumberOfClaims"]], ".",
      "Police report filed:", row[["PoliceReportFiled"]], ".",
      "Witness present:", row[["WitnessPresent"]], ".",
      "Agent type:", row[["AgentType"]], ".",
      "Number of supplements:", row[["NumberOfSuppliments"]], ".",
      "Address change claim:", row[["AddressChange.Claim"]], ".",
      "Number of cars:", row[["NumberOfCars"]], ".",
      "Month of accident:", row[["Month"]], ".",
      "Week of month:", row[["WeekOfMonth"]], ".",
      "Day of week:", row[["DayOfWeek"]], ".",
      "Month claimed:", row[["MonthClaimed"]], ".",
      "Week claimed:", row[["WeekOfMonthClaimed"]], ".",
      "Days policy accident:", row[["Days.Policy.Accident"]], ".",
      "Days policy claim:", row[["Days.Policy.Claim"]], "."
    )
  })
}
fix_single_level_factors <- function(df) {
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(col) {
    if (is.character(col)) col <- as.factor(col)
    if (is.factor(col)) {
      col <- droplevels(col)
      if (nlevels(col) < 2) {
        return(NULL)
      }
    }
    col
  })
  df <- df[, !sapply(df, is.null), drop = FALSE]
  df
}
```

6. Create Contextual Fraud Proxy
```{r}
# Rule-based suspicious patterns for Kenyan contextual validation
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    Previous_Claims_Count = if ("Previous_Claims_Count" %in% names(.)) safe_num(Previous_Claims_Count) else 0,
    Vehicle_Age = if ("Vehicle_Age" %in% names(.)) safe_num(Vehicle_Age) else 0,
    Monthly_Premium_KES = if ("Monthly_Premium_KES" %in% names(.)) safe_num(Monthly_Premium_KES) else 0,
    Accident_Cause = if ("Accident_Cause" %in% names(.)) safe_char(Accident_Cause) else "Unknown"
  )

kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    rule_high_freq_high_claim =
      ifelse(Previous_Claims_Count >= 3 & ClaimAmount >= quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),

    rule_old_vehicle_theft =
      ifelse(Vehicle_Age >= 8 &
               str_detect(tolower(Accident_Cause), "theft|stolen"), 1, 0),

    rule_many_claims_large_amount =
      ifelse(Previous_Claims_Count >= 2 & ClaimAmount >= quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0),

    rule_low_premium_high_claim =
      ifelse(Monthly_Premium_KES > 0 &
               ClaimAmount / Monthly_Premium_KES >= 40, 1, 0)
  )

kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    FraudProxyScore = rule_high_freq_high_claim +
      rule_old_vehicle_theft +
      rule_many_claims_large_amount +
      rule_low_premium_high_claim,
    FraudProxy = ifelse(FraudProxyScore >= 1, 1, 0)
  )

table(kenya_df$FraudProxy)
summary(kenya_df$FraudProxyScore)
```

```{r}
train_idx <- createDataPartition(kenya_df$FraudProxy, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

kenya_train <- kenya_df[train_idx, ]
kenya_test  <- kenya_df[-train_idx, ]

cat("Train rows:", nrow(kenya_train), "\n")
cat("Test rows :", nrow(kenya_test), "\n")
```

10. Kenyan Benchmark XGBoost Model
```{r}
benchmark_features <- c(
  "ClaimAmount", "VehicleCategory", "AccidentArea", "Age",
  "VehiclePrice", "Previous_Claims_Count", "Vehicle_Age",
  "Monthly_Premium_KES", "Accident_Cause"
)

benchmark_features <- intersect(benchmark_features, names(kenya_train))

x_train_bench <- kenya_train[, benchmark_features, drop = FALSE]
x_test_bench  <- kenya_test[, benchmark_features, drop = FALSE]
char_cols_bench <- names(x_train_bench)[sapply(x_train_bench, is.character)]
if (length(char_cols_bench) > 0) {
  x_train_bench[char_cols_bench] <- lapply(x_train_bench[char_cols_bench], as.factor)
  x_test_bench[char_cols_bench]  <- Map(
    function(x, lvl) factor(as.character(x), levels = lvl),
    x_test_bench[char_cols_bench],
    lapply(x_train_bench[char_cols_bench], levels)
  )
}

# Remove single-level factors before model.matrix
x_train_bench <- fix_single_level_factors(x_train_bench)

# Keep only same columns in test set
x_test_bench <- x_test_bench[, names(x_train_bench), drop = FALSE]

# Re-apply factor levels from training set
factor_cols_bench <- names(x_train_bench)[sapply(x_train_bench, is.factor)]
for (nm in factor_cols_bench) {
  x_test_bench[[nm]] <- factor(as.character(x_test_bench[[nm]]),
                               levels = levels(x_train_bench[[nm]]))
}

train_matrix <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = x_train_bench)
test_matrix  <- model.matrix(~ . - 1, data = x_test_bench)

missing_in_test <- setdiff(colnames(train_matrix), colnames(test_matrix))
for (nm in missing_in_test) {
  test_matrix <- cbind(test_matrix, rep(0, nrow(test_matrix)))
  colnames(test_matrix)[ncol(test_matrix)] <- nm
}

extra_in_test <- setdiff(colnames(test_matrix), colnames(train_matrix))
if (length(extra_in_test) > 0) {
  test_matrix <- test_matrix[, !colnames(test_matrix) %in% extra_in_test, drop = FALSE]
}

test_matrix <- test_matrix[, colnames(train_matrix), drop = FALSE]

dtrain_bench <- xgb.DMatrix(data = train_matrix, label = kenya_train$FraudProxy)
dtest_bench  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = test_matrix, label = kenya_test$FraudProxy)

params_bench <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "auc",
  max_depth = 4,
  eta = 0.1,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

kenya_benchmark_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params_bench,
  data = dtrain_bench,
  nrounds = 100,
  verbose = 0
)

kenya_benchmark_full_probs <- predict(kenya_benchmark_model, dtest_bench)
y_kenya <- kenya_test$FraudProxy

benchmark_results <- calc_metrics(y_true = y_kenya, probs = kenya_benchmark_full_probs, threshold = 0.5)
benchmark_results
```

```{r}
kenya_std[num_cols_std]  <- lapply(kenya_std[num_cols_std], safe_num)
```

13. Real XGBoost Predictions on Kenyan Data
```{r}
xgb_preprocess <- function(data) {
  out <- data %>%
    mutate(
      claim_to_value_ratio = ifelse(VehiclePrice == 0, 0, ClaimAmount / VehiclePrice),
      claims_per_year      = ifelse(PolicyTenure == 0, 0, PastNumberOfClaims / PolicyTenure),
      claim_month          = as.factor(Month),
      claim_day            = as.factor(DayOfWeek),
      high_risk_combo      = ifelse(PastNumberOfClaims > 2 & DriverRating < 3, 1, 0),
      vehicle_age_cat      = case_when(
        AgeOfVehicle <= 3 ~ "New",
        AgeOfVehicle <= 7 ~ "Medium",
        TRUE ~ "Old"
      )
    )

  out
}

xgb_artifacts <- readRDS(xgb_artifacts_path)
xgb_model <- xgb.load(xgb_model_path)

kenya_xgb_df <- xgb_preprocess(kenya_std)

drop_cols <- c("FraudFound", "FraudProxy", "FraudProxyScore", "PolicyNumber", "policy_id", "RowID")
kenya_xgb_X <- kenya_xgb_df %>% select(-any_of(drop_cols))

char_cols_xgb <- names(kenya_xgb_X)[sapply(kenya_xgb_X, is.character)]
if (length(char_cols_xgb) > 0) {
  kenya_xgb_X <- kenya_xgb_X %>% mutate(across(all_of(char_cols_xgb), as.factor))
}

# Remove single-level factors before dummy creation
kenya_xgb_X <- fix_single_level_factors(kenya_xgb_X)

factor_cols_xgb <- names(kenya_xgb_X)[sapply(kenya_xgb_X, is.factor)]
if (length(factor_cols_xgb) > 0) {
  kenya_xgb_X <- fastDummies::dummy_cols(
    kenya_xgb_X,
    select_columns = factor_cols_xgb,
    remove_first_dummy = TRUE,
    remove_selected_columns = TRUE
  )
}

kenya_xgb_X <- kenya_xgb_X %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ safe_num(.)))

trained_features <- xgb_artifacts$features

for (nm in setdiff(trained_features, names(kenya_xgb_X))) {
  kenya_xgb_X[[nm]] <- 0
}

kenya_xgb_X <- kenya_xgb_X[, trained_features, drop = FALSE]

xgb_predictions <- predict(xgb_model, xgb.DMatrix(as.matrix(kenya_xgb_X)))
summary(xgb_predictions)
```

15. Real GNN Predictions on Kenyan Data
```{r}
build_graph_objects <- function(df_input) {
  df_local <- df_input

  if (!"ClaimID" %in% names(df_local)) {
    df_local$ClaimID <- paste0("CLM_", seq_len(nrow(df_local)))
  }

  df_local$PolicyHolderID <- paste0("PH_", if ("RepNumber" %in% names(df_local)) safe_char(df_local$RepNumber) else seq_len(nrow(df_local)))
  df_local$AgentID <- paste0("AG_", if ("RepNumber" %in% names(df_local)) safe_char(df_local$RepNumber) else "UNK")
  garage_key <- paste(df_local$AccidentArea, df_local$Make, df_local$VehicleCategory, sep = "_")
  df_local$GarageID <- paste0("GAR_", as.integer(as.factor(garage_key)))

  numeric_cols <- intersect(
    c("Age", "ClaimAmount", "Deductible", "DriverRating", "NumberOfCars", "NumberOfSuppliments"),
    names(df_local)
  )

  categorical_candidates <- intersect(
    c("Sex", "MaritalStatus", "Fault", "PolicyType", "VehicleCategory",
      "PoliceReportFiled", "WitnessPresent", "AgentType", "BasePolicy",
      "AccidentArea", "VehiclePrice", "AgeOfVehicle", "Month",
      "MonthClaimed", "WeekOfMonth", "WeekOfMonthClaimed",
      "DayOfWeek", "Days.Policy.Accident", "Days.Policy.Claim",
      "PastNumberOfClaims", "Make"),
    names(df_local)
  )

 df_local[categorical_candidates] <- lapply(df_local[categorical_candidates], safe_char)
df_local[categorical_candidates] <- lapply(df_local[categorical_candidates], as.factor)

max_levels <- 20
categorical_cols <- categorical_candidates[
  sapply(df_local[categorical_candidates], function(x) {
    x <- droplevels(as.factor(x))
    nlevels(x) >= 2 && nlevels(x) <= max_levels
  })
]

X_num <- as.matrix(df_local[, numeric_cols, drop = FALSE])

if (length(categorical_cols) > 0) {
  cat_df <- df_local[, categorical_cols, drop = FALSE]
  cat_df <- fix_single_level_factors(cat_df)

  if (ncol(cat_df) > 0) {
    dummies <- caret::dummyVars(~ ., data = cat_df)
    X_cat <- predict(dummies, newdata = cat_df)
    X_cat <- as.matrix(X_cat)
  } else {
    X_cat <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_local), ncol = 0)
  }
} else {
  X_cat <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_local), ncol = 0)
}

  claim_features <- cbind(X_num, X_cat)
  claim_features[is.na(claim_features)] <- 0
  claim_features <- scale(claim_features)

  edges_claim_ph <- data.frame(from = df_local$ClaimID, to = df_local$PolicyHolderID)
  edges_claim_agent <- data.frame(from = df_local$ClaimID, to = df_local$AgentID)
  edges_claim_garage <- data.frame(from = df_local$ClaimID, to = df_local$GarageID)

  make_shared_edges <- function(data, col_name, max_group_size = 5) {
    if (!(col_name %in% names(data))) {
      return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character()))
    }
    groups <- split(data$ClaimID, data[[col_name]])
    groups <- groups[sapply(groups, length) > 1]

    out <- list()
    k <- 1
    for (ids in groups) {
      if (length(ids) > max_group_size) ids <- sample(ids, max_group_size)
      if (length(ids) < 2) next
      pairs <- combn(ids, 2)
      out[[k]] <- data.frame(from = pairs[1,], to = pairs[2,])
      k <- k + 1
    }
    if (length(out) == 0) return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character()))
    bind_rows(out)
  }

  edges_shared_rep <- make_shared_edges(df_local, "RepNumber", 5)
  edges_shared_area <- make_shared_edges(df_local, "AccidentArea", 5)

  edges <- bind_rows(
    edges_claim_ph, edges_claim_agent, edges_claim_garage,
    edges_shared_rep, edges_shared_area
  ) %>% distinct()

  claim_nodes <- data.frame(node_id = df_local$ClaimID, node_type = "claim")
  ph_nodes <- data.frame(node_id = unique(df_local$PolicyHolderID), node_type = "policyholder")
  agent_nodes <- data.frame(node_id = unique(df_local$AgentID), node_type = "agent")
  garage_nodes <- data.frame(node_id = unique(df_local$GarageID), node_type = "garage")

  nodes <- bind_rows(claim_nodes, ph_nodes, agent_nodes, garage_nodes) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(node_index = row_number() - 1)

  num_nodes <- nrow(nodes)
  num_features <- ncol(claim_features)

  X_all <- matrix(0, nrow = num_nodes, ncol = num_features)
  claim_idx <- match(df_local$ClaimID, nodes$node_id)
  X_all[claim_idx, ] <- claim_features

  edge_df <- edges %>%
    mutate(
      from_idx = match(from, nodes$node_id) - 1,
      to_idx   = match(to, nodes$node_id) - 1
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(from_idx), !is.na(to_idx)) %>%
    select(from_idx, to_idx)

  list(
    df = df_local,
    nodes = nodes,
    X_all = X_all,
    edge_index_df = as.matrix(edge_df),
    claim_idx = claim_idx
  )
}

train_final_gnn_and_predict <- function(kaggle_graph, kenya_graph, y_train_claims) {
  main <- reticulate::import_main(convert = FALSE)

  p_train <- ncol(kaggle_graph$X_all)
  p_test <- ncol(kenya_graph$X_all)

  if (p_test < p_train) {
    kenya_graph$X_all <- cbind(
      kenya_graph$X_all,
      matrix(0, nrow = nrow(kenya_graph$X_all), ncol = p_train - p_test)
    )
  } else if (p_test > p_train) {
    kenya_graph$X_all <- kenya_graph$X_all[, seq_len(p_train), drop = FALSE]
  }

  y_all <- rep(0L, nrow(kaggle_graph$nodes))
  y_all[kaggle_graph$claim_idx] <- as.integer(y_train_claims)

  train_mask <- rep(FALSE, nrow(kaggle_graph$nodes))
  train_mask[kaggle_graph$claim_idx] <- TRUE

  claim_mask_kenya <- rep(FALSE, nrow(kenya_graph$nodes))
  claim_mask_kenya[kenya_graph$claim_idx] <- TRUE

  main$X_train_all <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.matrix(kaggle_graph$X_all))
  main$y_train_all <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.integer(y_all))
  main$train_mask  <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.integer(train_mask))
  main$edge_train  <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.matrix(kaggle_graph$edge_index_df))

  main$X_kenya_all <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.matrix(kenya_graph$X_all))
  main$claim_mask_kenya <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.integer(claim_mask_kenya))
  main$edge_kenya <- reticulate::r_to_py(as.matrix(kenya_graph$edge_index_df))

  reticulate::py_run_string("
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def build_adj(edge_index_np, num_nodes):
    row = edge_index_np[:,0]
    col = edge_index_np[:,1]

    self_loops = np.arange(num_nodes)
    row = np.concatenate([row, self_loops])
    col = np.concatenate([col, self_loops])

    indices = torch.tensor(np.vstack([row, col]), dtype=torch.long)
    values = torch.ones(indices.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32)

    A = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(indices, values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()

    deg = torch.zeros(num_nodes, dtype=torch.float32)
    deg.index_add_(0, A.indices()[0], A.values())
    deg = torch.clamp(deg, min=1.0)
    deg_inv_sqrt = torch.pow(deg, -0.5)

    r = A.indices()[0]
    c = A.indices()[1]
    norm_values = deg_inv_sqrt[r] * A.values() * deg_inv_sqrt[c]
    norm_values = torch.nan_to_num(norm_values, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    A_hat = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(A.indices(), norm_values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()
    return A_hat

class GCNLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_features, out_features)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        X = self.linear(X)
        return torch.sparse.mm(A_hat, X)

class GCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_dim, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.gcn1 = GCNLayer(in_features, hidden_dim)
        self.gcn2 = GCNLayer(hidden_dim, out_features)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        x = self.gcn1(X, A_hat)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.gcn2(x, A_hat)
        return x

X_np = np.array(X_train_all, dtype=np.float32)
y_np = np.array(y_train_all, dtype=np.int64)
train_mask_np = np.array(train_mask, dtype=bool)
edge_train_np = np.array(edge_train, dtype=np.int64)

X = torch.tensor(np.nan_to_num(X_np), dtype=torch.float32)
y = torch.tensor(y_np, dtype=torch.long)
train_mask_t = torch.tensor(train_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)

A_hat = build_adj(edge_train_np, X.shape[0])

model = GCN(in_features=X.shape[1], hidden_dim=16, out_features=2)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, weight_decay=1e-4)

num_pos = int((y[train_mask_t] == 1).sum().item())
num_neg = int((y[train_mask_t] == 0).sum().item())
class_weights = torch.tensor([1.0, num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)], dtype=torch.float32)

for epoch in range(1, 101):
    model.train()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    out = model(X, A_hat)
    out = torch.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    loss = F.cross_entropy(out[train_mask_t], y[train_mask_t], weight=class_weights)
    loss.backward()
    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
    optimizer.step()

Xk_np = np.array(X_kenya_all, dtype=np.float32)
claim_mask_kenya_np = np.array(claim_mask_kenya, dtype=bool)
edge_kenya_np = np.array(edge_kenya, dtype=np.int64)

Xk = torch.tensor(np.nan_to_num(Xk_np), dtype=torch.float32)
A_hat_k = build_adj(edge_kenya_np, Xk.shape[0])

model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    logits_k = model(Xk, A_hat_k)
    logits_k = torch.nan_to_num(logits_k, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    probs_k = F.softmax(logits_k, dim=1)[:, 1].cpu().numpy()

probs_k = np.nan_to_num(probs_k, nan=0.5, posinf=0.5, neginf=0.5)
gnn_claim_probs_kenya = probs_k[claim_mask_kenya_np]
")

  main2 <- reticulate::import_main(convert = TRUE)
  as.numeric(main2$gnn_claim_probs_kenya)
}

# Ensure Kaggle and Kenya both have required fields
for (nm in names(required_defaults)) {
  if (!nm %in% names(kaggle_df)) kaggle_df[[nm]] <- required_defaults[[nm]]
  if (!nm %in% names(kenya_std)) kenya_std[[nm]] <- required_defaults[[nm]]
}

kaggle_graph <- build_graph_objects(kaggle_df)
kenya_graph  <- build_graph_objects(kenya_std)

gnn_predictions <- train_final_gnn_and_predict(
  kaggle_graph = kaggle_graph,
  kenya_graph = kenya_graph,
  y_train_claims = kaggle_df$FraudFound
)

summary(gnn_predictions)
```

16. Final Ensemble Inference Using Real Base Predictions
```{r}
stopifnot(length(xgb_predictions) == nrow(kenya_df))
stopifnot(length(lstm_predictions) == nrow(kenya_df))
stopifnot(length(gnn_predictions) == nrow(kenya_df))

meta_glm <- readRDS(meta_glm_path)
best_threshold <- readRDS(best_threshold_path)

kenya_meta <- data.frame(
  PXGB  = as.numeric(xgb_predictions),
  PLSTM = as.numeric(lstm_predictions),
  PGNN  = as.numeric(gnn_predictions)
)

kenya_meta$FinalProb <- predict(meta_glm, newdata = kenya_meta, type = "response")
kenya_meta$FinalPred <- ifelse(kenya_meta$FinalProb >= best_threshold, 1, 0)

# attach ensemble outputs back to the FULL Kenyan dataset first
kenya_df$PXGB      <- kenya_meta$PXGB
kenya_df$PLSTM     <- kenya_meta$PLSTM
kenya_df$PGNN      <- kenya_meta$PGNN
kenya_df$FinalProb <- kenya_meta$FinalProb
kenya_df$FinalPred <- kenya_meta$FinalPred

head(kenya_df[, c("ClaimID", "PXGB", "PLSTM", "PGNN", "FinalProb", "FinalPred")])
```
